lessons.correction: Focus on economy and expansion, but start building up production and army. Maintain a defensive posture.
lessons.mistake: Continuing to expand and strengthen ground army without first building up production and scouting, leaving you vulnerable to early aggression.
lessons.recheck: Recheck when you have more information about the opponent's composition.
lessons.title: Avoid over-expanding without army support
lessons.when: Early game, around 180 seconds, when you have a heavy economy and expansion but light production and tech, and opponent's posture is unknown.
lessons.why: Your economy is strong, so you can afford to expand and tech. The opponent's unknown posture means you should be cautious.

lessons.correction: Increase your economy and tech, while maintaining your production and expansion. Keep a defensive posture.
lessons.mistake: Increasing economy and tech without scouting, potentially leaving you unprepared for the opponent's strategy and neglecting army production.
lessons.recheck: Recheck when you have more scouting information.
lessons.title: Avoid blind teching without scouting
lessons.when: Early midgame, around 240 seconds, when you have a heavy economy and expansion but light production and tech, and opponent's posture is unknown.
lessons.why: Your economy is strong, so you can invest in tech. The opponent's unknown posture means you should be cautious.

lessons.correction: Increase your economy, production, and expansion, while continuing to develop your ground army. Consider adding anti-air.
lessons.mistake: Continuing to strengthen ground army and expand without adding anti-air, leaving you vulnerable to the opponent's air units.
lessons.recheck: Recheck when you have more information about the opponent's air composition.
lessons.title: Avoid neglecting ground defense against air-heavy opponent
lessons.when: Midgame, around 540 seconds, when you have a heavy economy, production, expansion, and tech, and opponent has an air posture with heavy production and tech.
lessons.why: The opponent's air threat requires a response, so you need to prepare anti-air while maintaining your economy.
